  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.

  .
  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Beginning July 1, 2026, all City Council Meetings are conducted in a hybrid model per Senate Bill
  707 (2025). Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers, watch and
  participate in the meeting through Zoom, or watch the meeting through a Live Stream (City
  Website), Cable TV Channel 10 or watch a recording after the fact of the meeting (City Video
  Archives). City Council Chamber doors open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  Zoom participants are automatically muted and may view, listen, and provide audio public
  comment when permitted (see “Public Comment/Public Participation”). Meetings are recorded,
  and all rules of decorum apply to both in-person and remote participants.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting, may
  submit written comments via email before or at the meeting or attend virtually and provide
  comments. Public comments must address an agenda item or an item within the subject matter
  jurisdiction of the City Council.

  When attending in-person, submit a Public Speaker card or Written Comment card to the City
  Clerk prior to the start of the Public Comments period for non-agenda items or prior to the agenda
  item being called.

  3272210.2
 When attending through Zoom, follow the instructions to indicate you wish to speak during the
meeting. You will be asked to raise your hands via Zoom (audio only; cameras will not be
activated for the public). When recognized by the City Clerk, unmute your microphone (Zoom
Host will grant permission) and provide comments. At the conclusion of your time, your ability to
unmute will be removed by the Zoom host. Individuals joining by telephone, press *9 to raise your
hand and when called upon by the City Clerk, press *6 to unmute and provide comments. Remote
participants must be present when called and are responsible for ensuring that they are connected
and able to hear the meeting.

Public speakers are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for
meeting management purposes. A speaker’s time may not be transferred to another speaker.
Remote public speakers will receive the same time allotment as a member of the public
commenting in person.

Please be mindful that the meeting will be recorded and all rules of decorum apply for in-person
and virtual attendees.

WRITTEN COMMENT
Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets. Written
comments will not be read aloud by the City. A summary including the number of emails and
contents may be provided by the City Clerk.

Remote Access Disruption
In accordance with the Brown Act and City Council Resolution No. 2459-26, if the internet or
telephone service for the Zoom Host (City) goes down during the meeting, a recess will be called
for the meeting to allow staff to investigate the issue.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary
aids or services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a central
 location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications. Sign up using
 “Notify Me” https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the
 meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours and are posted on the
 City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 Watch the City Council Meeting Video LIVE or to rewatch a prior meeting video, click “City Council
 Agendas, Minutes & Video” (http://westlakevillage.granicus.com/viewpublisher.php?view_id=8) City
 Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org

3272210.2
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

Minutes of September 9, 2026 City Council Regular Meeting.

1.  LAS VIRGENES-MALIBU COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS REGIONAL SMART
  CITIES FIBER NETWORK PROJECT UPDATE

2.  Pure Water Project Update - Verbal Report

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. See pages 1 and 2 for instructions on speaking in-person and virtually.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

4.  Supervisor’s Office Verbal Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

 1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 06-001, MODIFICATION NO. 3; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2469-26 - Determining Modification No. 3 of Conditional Use Permit No. 06-
  001, is exempt from CEQA and authorize the continued sale of alcoholic
  beverages for on-site consumption located at 30970 Russell Ranch Road (Lure
  Fish House).

3272210.2
   RESOLUTION NO. 2469-26 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO.
  06-001, MODIFICATION NO. 3 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED SALE OF
  ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IN CONJUNCTION WITH A RESTAURANT
  LOCATED AT 30970 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD (LURE FISH HOUSE).

 2.  INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE ADDING CHAPTER 9.47 (ARTERIAL VIEWS
  OVERLAY ZONE) TO THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE,
  AMENDING THE ZONING MAP TO ESTABLISH BOUNDARIES OF THE
  OVERLAY DISTRICT, AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION; ORDINANCE NO. 317-26 - Determine that Ordinance No.
  317-26 is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act, waive full reading
  and introduce the ordinance, and schedule adoption of the ordinance for October
  14, 2026.

  ORDINANCE NO. 317-26 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE ADDING CHAPTER 9.47 TO THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL
  CODE TO ESTABLISH AN ARTERIAL VIEWS OVERLAY ZONE, AMENDING
  THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE ZONING MAP TO ESTABLISH BOUNDARIES FOR
  THE ARTERIAL VIEWS OVERLAY ZONE, AND APPROVING A CEQA
  EXEMPTION DETERMINATION.

 3.  INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTIONS 9.14.070 AND
  9.14.080 OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE PERTAINING TO
  ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS; ORDINANCE NO. 318-26 - Determine
  Ordinance No. 318-26 is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), that full reading of the ordinance be waived, that adoption of the
  ordinance be scheduled for October 14, 2026.

  ORDINANCE NO. 318-26 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE AMENDING SECTION 9.14.070 AND SECTION 9.14.080 OF THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO REVISE ACCESSORY DWELLING
  UNIT AND JUNIOR ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT REGULATIONS AND
  APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION.

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

3272210.2
   APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective September 15, 2026 in the
  amount of $471,821.43 (Warrant Register is on file with the City Clerk)

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 316-26. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING CHAPTER
  7.5 TO ESTABLISH SPEED LIMITS ON VARIOUS ROADWAYS IN THE
  CITY - Waive the second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 316-26.

  ORDINANCE NO. 316-26 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING CHAPTER 7.5 TO ESTABLISH SPEED
  LIMITS ON VARIOUS ROADWAYS IN THE CITY

  2.  ACCEPTANCE OF ANNUAL STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2025-26; FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the
  Annual Street Improvement Project for Fiscal Year 2025-26 and authorize
  the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for the project
  on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

  1. ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR
  COMMUNITY PARK TRASH ENCLOSURE PROJECT - Determine that the
  Community Park Trash Enclosure Project is exempt from CEQA, adopt the plans
  and specifications for the Community Park Trash Enclosure Project and authorize
  staff to advertise bids for the Community Park Trash Enclosure Project.

  2. ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR THE
  BERNIECE BENNETT PARK RESTROOM REHABILITATION PROJECT -
  Adopt the plans and specifications for the Berniece Bennett Park Restroom
  Rehabilitation Project, authorize staff to advertise for bids for the Berniece Bennett
  Park Restroom Rehabilitation Project, find the Berniece Bennett Park Restroom
  Rehabilitation Project exempt from CEQA pursuant to CEQA Guidelines sections
  15301, 15302, and 15061(b)(3), and authorize staff to file a Notice of Exemption
  with the Los Angeles County Clerk.

NEW BUSINESS:

  1. ADJUSTMENT OF MEDICAL PREMIUM RATES AND EMPLOYER
  CONTRIBUTIONS FOR ACTIVE AND RETIRED EMPLOYEES EFFECTIVE
  JANUARY 1, 2027; RESOLUTION 2470-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2470-26, to
  Amend Resolution No. 1564-11 to Increase the Insurance Coverage Benefit for
  Full-Time Active and Retired Employees.

3272210.2
   RESOLUTION NO. 2470-26 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 1564-11
  ADJUSTING MEDICAL PREMIUM RATES AND EMPLOYER CONTRIBUTIONS
  FOR ACTIVE AND RETIRED EMPLOYEES

  2. UPDATE ON MEASURE G – GOVERNANCE REFORM TASK FORCE
  RECOMMENDATIONS AND COUNTY-CITY RELATIONS - City Council to
  receive and file this report

  3. RATIFICATION OF THE PURCHASE OF A COMMUNITY TROLLEY AND
  REQUEST FOR A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR THE PURCHASE AND
  NEEDED REPAIRS AND REFURBISHMENT - Approve a budget amendment in
  the amount of $230,496.87 for purchase of the 2004 Ford Trolley and authorize
  the City Manager to approve needed repairs of up to $200,000.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. on the City’s
website and in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  September 24, 2026
